Definitely recommend both of these movies if anyone hasn't seen them.

I watched it with my brother and he didn't like the ending, he said he wanted to see him succeed more at being a drummer, like after that performance go on and become a famous drummer, get the girl, etc. But I disagree - the ending as it is makes the movie WAY better. To me it would have made Whiplash more boring - coming down from that show and seeing everything wrap up in a pretty bow. That ending was incredible as is and I wouldn't change a thing.
